theme: Minnesota common snapping turtles and muddy-bank ambush: a low hatchling develops a huge hooked beak, thick telescoping neck, three broad shell ridges and a long saw-ridged tail. Its shell is living keratin and its low stance follows a real turtle; no cannons or carried objects.
habitat: Muddy pond bottoms, slow rivers and shallow vegetated lake margins.
